decisions.title: Function result printed before array outputs, while the Fortran driver prints it after
decisions.reason: The only part of the finding verifiable from the supplied patch is the Rust-side ordering: the FN template in the new file clearly emits `println!("{:.15e}", _result as f64)` (the cited line) BEFORE the `{rust_prints}` array-output block, so the Rust example does print the scalar result first. However, the rest of the failure chain lives in code not present in the shipped patch: `generate_fortran_driver` (the claimed array loops at lines 418-441 and the return-value WRITE at line 471, with the comment '# Print the function result after all array prints') and the actual comparison logic that would pair the two streams positionally are not shown in this hunk. Without seeing that the Fortran driver really appends the result after the arrays and that the comparator is positional (rather than matching by name/label), the asserted mismatch cannot be confirmed nor refuted. The visible code is consistent with the claim but does not by itself establish the bug.
